name: Tuna Curry
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3 tbsp (45 g / 45 ml) butter or olive oil
100 g (3½ oz) frozen vegetables, such as carrot slices, green beans, or peas
1 can (150 g/5¼ oz) tuna in water, drained

steps: Heat the oil or melt the butter in a saucepan.
Sauté the onion in the butter or olive oil until transparent.
Add the flour and stir until the flour is completely incorporated.
Add the curry powder and stir until it is completely incorporated.
Add the milk and frozen veggies and stir until the mixture gets hot again.
Salt and pepper to taste. Tuna is naturally salty, so add the tuna before tasting.
Heat thoroughly and serve over rice.

culture.text: Curry is a dish with a spicy sauce, initially in Indian cuisine, then modified by interchange with the Portuguese, followed by the British, and eventually thoroughly internationalised. Many curries are found in the cuisines of countries in Southeast Asia and East Asia.
